purpose: Test whether a train-fitted diagonal Fourier likelihood gives calibrated present-density posteriors on TNG validation mocks
scope_warning: This is a linearized present-density self-consistency test, not an IC or forward-dynamics validation

evaluation.independence_caveat: The validation split was used for historical deterministic checkpoint selection, so a pass is self-consistency evidence rather than a final independent gate

model.basis: orthonormal periodic rFFT of each 20 Mpc/h mock cube
model.likelihood: mean_k = T_eff(k) truth_k + n_k; n_k Gaussian with diagonal band power P_n(k)
model.prior: empirical TNG-train present-day log-density band power; only for this falsification test

frozen_gate.failure_decision: Remove the Hong density stage from the IC inference path and retain velocity-only constraints

result.decision: The global stationary Fourier likelihood is underdispersed on validation mocks; stop the Hong density-likelihood IC branch and retain velocity-only constraints
